title: GUI fidelity: establish Supply dialog multi-provider ordering, limits and selection
body:
Requested by the owner after v0.8.2 during a GPT-6.1 Sol high-reasoning provenance audit. This is an evidence gap, not a proven gameplay defect.

Current remake: [SupplyProviders.ForArmy](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/src/IC2.Engine/Economy/SupplyProviders.cs#L52) lists all eligible cities in state order, then fleets in state order. [SupplyDialogModel.Refresh for fleets](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/godot/UI/Dialogs/SupplyDialogModel.cs#L353) similarly enumerates cities/fleets and retains a selected index. Agreement with the command handler proves internal consistency, not original GUI parity.

The [promoted supply report](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-09-supply-providers-and-transfer-clamps.md) explicitly leaves “The Supply dialog with several providers: whether the player can choose among them, and in what order they are listed” unestablished. Its code reading describes up to two cities and three own fleets. Do not repeat its already measured single-provider cases or treat every old report limit as current without checking later findings.

Questions / experiment:
- Trace TAFSupply_FindProviders (0x43f468), initialization, list selection and transfer callbacks: scan order, list caps, default selection, duplicate/self exclusion, and whether all eligible providers are reachable.
- Construct minimal controls with multiple eligible cities/fleets (up to and beyond the documented limits where legal). Give each distinguishable stock/money; vary table order independently of position, own versus non-hostile foreign city, and source stock.
- Observe visible provider rows, default row and each selectable row; transfer one known amount and verify the actual donor/receiver before/after. Check switching providers and OK/Cancel without assuming transaction timing.
- Separate the fleet menu's opening scan quirk from the dialog's provider enumeration.

Owner-approved army providers and the extra money-source picker are designed QoL extensions, not behaviors this task should remove or “prove original.” Return an exact original city/fleet policy and identify any remaining design decision.

Deliver a bounded report with exact original EXE/runtime identity, code sites, control matrix, observations versus inference, evidence locations and explicit limits. Use separate synthetic/private copies, preserve source files, and keep original bytes/screenshots/private save hashes out of public GitHub. Coordinate any native Windows execution with the owner; do not interrupt a running game. Research only: no remake implementation or automatic design changes.
